heading: Authorization of appropriations

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated—

children.text: $4,600,000 to carry out section 9621 of this title; and
$107,500,000 to carry out section 9622 of this title; and
such sums as may be necessary for each of the 5 succeeding fiscal years to carry out sections 9621 and 9622 of this title.

tree.heading: Availability
tree.text: Amounts made available under this section shall remain available until expended.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 107–279, title III, § 305, formerly § 303, Nov. 5, 2002, 116 Stat. 1982; renumbered § 305, Pub. L. 107–279, title IV, § 401(b), Nov. 5, 2002, 116 Stat. 1983.)
